integrity: Analytic Laplacian-mode proof, exact rational two-community equilibrium and Jacobian determinant; executable symbolic and finite-network checks; general Turing methods and higher-order epidemic bistability pre-exist this model-specific result.
scientific_limitations: Local deterministic stability in a quadratic self-exposure SIS--opinion specialization with symmetric opinion Laplacian; general spectral equality and mixed-sign and boundary equilibria are outside the theorem; no stochastic or global results.
title: Sharp opinion-network destabilization of a higher-order SIS endemic equilibrium
